Age: early thirties — a poised, mature face with defined cheekbones and jaw; at most faint lines, no deep folds or under-eye bags.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish.

Her: a mature, poised woman; warm beige skin; oval face; moderately sized, realistically proportioned eyes — wide almond eyes, outer eye corners drooping downward; soft rounded brows; straight narrow nose; full heart-shaped lips; coral-orange eyes; a small beauty mark beside the lips. statuesque, long-legged, with a natural neck length build; an updo bun with side-swept bangs; lustrous pearl-white hair with a pink-and-silver nacre sheen.

Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin — never a long face or a long, pointed or heavy jaw; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline and never lengthens her face. Her eyes keep the shape described above at a natural open size — never squeezed into narrow slits.

Her element: calcium: the element living things build their bodies with — bone and teeth, seashells and pearls with a pink-and-silver nacre sheen; limestone cliffs laid down by countless shells, white marble statues, chalk, stalactites dripping for ten thousand years; pale, strong and patient. Palette: pearl white, bone ivory, marble grey veining, coral pink, limestone cream.

World and costume: a sea kingdom of white limestone cliffs and coral reefs: a marble temple of statues above the waves, a pearl divers' lagoon, a cathedral cave of stalactites and still pools. COSTUME (fantasy): a high-fantasy royal or warrior costume — plate pauldrons or a gorget, mail or scale over a long tabard or robe, a circlet or crown, a flowing cape; metal ornament and regalia built from the traits above, subtle magical glow along the patterns. No corset, no bustle, no Victorian tailoring, no modern material, no machinery. LIGHT: natural daylight or the world's own magical glow, unless TIME & WEATHER says otherwise.

Outfit silhouette: a light breastplate and bracers with robe panels split from the waist — half armor, half robe. Only the overall shape is fixed; design the details freely in the element's materials and palette. This silhouette overrides the overall shape of the costume above.

EXPOSURE (bold): her regalia opens to show skin — bare shoulders and arms between pauldron and bracer, a deep open neckline under the gorget with natural cleavage, a high slit in the tabard or robe showing the thigh; armor pieces stay on and symmetrical. Nothing slipped off. Intimate areas covered; no corset; keep the costume WORLD describes, material and palette.

Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer. Expression: softly lowered brows, warm relaxed eyes, faint closed-lip smile, no tension anywhere.

Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

Light: the scene's own light, rendered the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure only, natural hands with five fingers; no text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (Ca) and atomic number (20) — and those only as part of the scene: engraved, embroidered or glowing on her costume, a banner, a sign or a machine, never as a floating label, corner badge, periodic-table tile, caption or overlay on the picture; no logo or watermark.
